summary: items bulk-set must only coerce a --set value to a JSON boolean when the collection schema says the field is a Switch; otherwise a plain-text field whose value is literally "true" or "false" gets silently retyped and Webflow rejects or mis-stores the write.
reason: stringMapToAny coerced any value matching "true"/"false" (case-insensitive) to a JSON bool with no reference to the field's actual type. A regen must keep the coercion scoped to fields whose schema type is exactly "Switch" (fetched the same way collections_completeness already fetches collection schema: local mirror first, one live GET as fallback), and must default to leaving the value as a string when the schema is unavailable rather than guessing from the value.
validated_outcome: Unit test TestStringMapToAnyOnlyCoercesSwitchFields confirms a PlainText field valued "false" stays a JSON string while a Switch field valued "true" becomes a JSON bool.
